Contact JAPANESE ENGLISH Contact JAPANESE TOP R&D Inquiries about research and development Inquiries about research and development This form is for inquiries about NTT's research and development activities. When making online inquiries: Please state your query as clearly as possible. Depending on the nature of your query, we may not be able to provide an answer and we ask for your understanding in advance. Any information we receive from you will be used exclusively for the purpose of our reply. It is strictly prohibited to use our response elsewhere or for secondary purposes.
